task.title: Record the L1.8 smaller-model re-scope on the tracker

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.1 stays in_progress with a note naming the owner's smaller-model re-scope, both packs and their NOT RUN state, nothing is closed, every blocks edge is unchanged, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard still reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree', run once against the final state after `bd update awkit-djnl.1 --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl`, the two named benchmark scripts in package.json and the state-document updates.
